newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Caltex Bahrain issues 2H 1997 naphtha sale tender.
newsitem.headline: Caltex Bahrain issues 2H 1997 naphtha sale tender.

text.p: Caltex Bahrain has issued a term tender to sell six 25,000-tonne cargoes of light naphtha (B220) for lifting in June-December 1997, industry sources said on Friday.
The tender closes on January 3 and bids are valid to January 10.
The naphtha on offer is lighter than that sold by Bahrain National Oil Co (BANOCO) earlier this month in a one-year term tender.
Traders said BANOCO sold about one million tonnes of naphtha at a premium of about $11.00 to $11.50 over the mean of MidEast quotes for 1997.
Traders said they expected Caltex to achieve a higher premium than that secured by BANOCO.
